root_cause_investigation_hint: scripts/check_branch_freshness.sh — investigate why local base was stale before rebase. Common cause: rebased against stale origin/main snapshot without git fetch first. Fix: use scripts/safe_push.sh which fetches + auto-rebases + pushes atomically.
closure_evidence: Root cause found and fixed rather than accounted for again. The freshness check resolved HEAD instead of the ref being pushed, so pushing letters to the letters branch while a code branch was checked out produced a verdict about the code branch - true statement, wrong subject - and I read the block as being about my push and reached for the override. Seven of these in one day, every one the intended action. Fixed in scripts/check_branch_freshness.sh, which now reads the ref lines the pre-push hook receives, with refs-given, deletion-only and nothing-on-stdin kept as three distinct states; and in setup/setup-hooks.sh, which had captured those lines all along and never passed them on. The defect was already written down in that file's own comment as open. THE PROOF: the letters branch really was 22 behind main, so I merged main into it rather than exempting it - letters went from 2107 to 2120, zero behind - and then pushed it with NO freshness override at all. That push filed no error. This row is the last one from before the fix.
